subjects.name: Casa de Dom Inácio de Loyola

summary: Brazilian Spiritist medium John of God ran a psychic-surgery center in Abadiania, Goias, promoted to Western audiences by Oprah Winfrey, while sexually abusing hundreds of women; he was convicted of rape in 2019.

evidence.note: birth in 1942 in a village in Goias, from the follower-written biography
arrival in Abadiania and founding of the Casa; transcript garbles the year
Kardec's Spiritism and earlier Brazilian psychic surgeons given as background
passionflower pill pharmacy, white clothes, crystals and hotel cut as the money machine
O Magazine article and Dr. Oz lending credibility; long media critique segment
Oprah show episode and Dr. Rediger presented as a skeptic, critiqued at length
daughter alleges he abused her from age 10 to 14; baby-selling claims follow
accuser driven abroad by threats; a victim hounded into suicide
December 2019 sentence of over 19 years for raping four women
Abadiania described as his personal fiefdom built on pilgrim tourism

notes: Transcript dates the military coup to 1962 (it was 1964) and garbles the Abadiania arrival year; main_span start 1976 from general knowledge, so approximate. Ze Arigo, Rubens Farias and Kardec treated as background, not covered years. Subject still alive at release, so covered_span ends 2020.
